description_en: Queries the attach relationships between accelerated IP addresses and endpoints of a basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用ListBasicAccelerateIpEndpointRelations接口查询基础型全球加速实例的加速IP和终端节点的绑定关系
name: ListBasicAccelerateIpEndpointRelations

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of a request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The endpoint ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the accelerated IP address of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的加速IP实例ID
parameters.name: accelerate_ip_id

parameters.help_en:
The token that determines the start point of the next query. Valid values:
If this is the first query or no subsequent query is to be sent, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a subsequent query is to be sent, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when you query results in batches. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

AccelerateIpEndpointRelations.description_en: The list of attach relationships between accelerated IP addresses and endpoints of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
AccelerateIpEndpointRelations.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的加速IP和终端节点绑定关系列表

items.description_en: The list of attach relationships between accelerated IP addresses and endpoints of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
items.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的加速IP和终端节点绑定关系列表

AccelerateIpId.description_en: The instance ID of the accelerated IP address of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
AccelerateIpId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的加速IP实例ID

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance

EndpointId.description_en: The endpoint ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
EndpointId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点ID

EndpointName.description_en: The name of the endpoint of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
EndpointName.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例终端节点的名称

EndpointSubAddress.description_en:
The secondary address of the endpoint.

This parameter is returned when the endpoint type attached to the accelerated IP address is ECS, ENI, or NLB.
If the endpoint type is ECS, EndpointSubAddress is the secondary private IP address or the primary private IP address of the primary network interface controller (NIC).
If the endpoint type is ENI, EndpointSubAddress is the secondary private IP address or the primary private IP address of the secondary network interface controller (NIC).
If the endpoint type is NLB, EndpointSubAddress is the primary private IP address of the NLB backend server
EndpointSubAddress.description_zh:
终端节点辅助地址。

当加速IP所绑定终端节点类型为ECS、ENI或NLB时，返回该参数。
当终端节点类型为ECS时，EndpointSubAddress为主网卡的辅助私网IP或主网卡的主私网IP。
当终端节点类型为ENI时，EndpointSubAddress为辅助网卡的辅助私网IP或辅助网卡的主私网IP。
当终端节点类型为NLB时，EndpointSubAddress为NLB后端服务器的主私网IP

EndpointSubAddressType.description_en:
The type of the endpoint secondary address. Valid values:
primary: The endpoint secondary address type is the primary private IP address.
secondary: The endpoint secondary address type is the secondary private IP address.

This parameter is returned when the endpoint type bound to the accelerated IP address is ECS, ENI, or NLB. If the endpoint type is NLB, only the primary type is returned
EndpointSubAddressType.description_zh:
终端节点辅助地址的类型。
primary：终端节点辅助地址的类型为主私网IP。
secondary：终端节点辅助地址的类型为辅助私网IP。

当加速IP所绑定终端节点类型为ECS、ENI或NLB时，返回该参数。其中，终端节点类型为NLB时，仅返回primary类型

EndpointType.description_en:
The endpoint type. Valid values:
ENI: Alibaba Cloud elastic network interfaces (ENIs).
SLB: Alibaba Cloud Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.
ECS: Alibaba Cloud ECS instance.
NLB: Alibaba Cloud Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
EndpointType.description_zh:
终端节点类型。
ENI：阿里云弹性网卡。
SLB：阿里云CLB实例。
ECS：阿里云ECS实例。
NLB：阿里云NLB实例

EndpointZoneId.description_en:
The zone ID of the endpoint.

Currently, this parameter is returned only when the endpoint type bound to the accelerated IP address is NLB
EndpointZoneId.description_zh:
终端节点所在可用区ID。

目前，仅当加速IP所绑定终端节点类型为NLB时，返回该参数

IpAddress.description_en: The accelerated IP address of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
IpAddress.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的加速IP

State.description_en:
The attach status between the accelerated IP address and the endpoint of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

The value active is returned, which indicates that the attach relationship is established
State.description_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的加速IP和终端节点绑定状态。

返回active，表示已绑定

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page when results are queried in batches
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that determines the start point of the next query. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query is to be sent.
If a value of NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
